name: What common challenges might I face when selling a waterfront home and how can I prepare for them?

mainEntity.name: What common challenges might I face when selling a waterfront home and how can I prepare for them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges when selling a waterfront home include stricter inspection processes for marine structures, potential issues with environmental regulations, and a smaller, more specialized buyer pool. To prepare, ensure all permits for docks and seawalls are up-to-date, have a recent survey, and disclose any known property limitations related to the waterfront. This preparation provides process clarity by proactively addressing issues that might arise during due diligence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Anticipate stricter inspections for marine structures and environmental compliance. Prepare by updating permits, having a recent survey, and disclosing limitations.
